CustomField.description: Checked when a reviewer has parked this code review until the dealer answers. On-hold reviews show on the On Hold tab with on-hold rows instead of under Dealer Code Reviews. Cleared when the review is settled (confirm holder, credit, re-match, decide rows one by one) or released. The held rows stay held either way, because the code itself holds them.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked while this code review waits for an answer from the dealer.
CustomField.label: On Hold
